title: Client Anti Place TP
features:
This is a client-sided anti-place-teleporting script. This is useful for spam games that teleport you to many different places, etc.

Works in auto-exec, compatible with any decent exploit that supports hookmetamethod & hookfunction.

Showcase: https://streamable.com/9ds6gk

(Note: This won't bypass server-sided teleports such as DH or Jailbreak. Don't expect this to be a ban bypass)
